description_en: Queries the summary, conclusion status, and analysis time of AI analysis reports for a specified event by using paging. This paged query returns the results in descending order of report generation time. For the full text, call DescribeIncidentInvestigation
description_zh: 分页查询指定事件的 AI 分析报告摘要、结论状态和分析时间，按报告生成时间倒序返回。完整正文请通过 DescribeIncidentInvestigation 查询
name: ListIncidentInvestigations

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security event. You can obtain the ID by calling ListIncidents
parameters.help_zh: 安全事件 ID，可从 ListIncidents 获取
parameters.name: incident_uuid

parameters.help_en: The language of the returned content. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 返回内容的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文，默认中文
parameters.name: lang

Data.description_en: The query results or the data returned by the operation
Data.description_zh: 查询结果或操作返回数据

List.description_en: The list of results on the current page

items.description_en: The summary information of an AI analysis report, excluding the full text of the report
items.description_zh: 一份 AI 分析报告的摘要信息，不包含报告正文

IncidentInvestigationEndTime.description_en: The end time of the AI analysis. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
IncidentInvestigationEndTime.description_zh: AI 分析结束时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
IncidentInvestigationEndTime.title_en: AI分析结束时间（秒级时间戳）
IncidentInvestigationEndTime.title_zh: AI分析结束时间（秒级时间戳）

IncidentInvestigationId.description_en: The ID of the AI analysis report. You can obtain the ID by calling ListIncidentInvestigations
IncidentInvestigationId.description_zh: AI 分析报告 ID，可从 ListIncidentInvestigations 获取

IncidentInvestigationStartTime.description_en: The start time of the AI analysis. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
IncidentInvestigationStartTime.description_zh: AI 分析开始时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
IncidentInvestigationStartTime.title_en: AI分析开始时间（秒级时间戳）
IncidentInvestigationStartTime.title_zh: AI分析开始时间（秒级时间戳）

IncidentInvestigationStatus.description_en: The conclusion status of the AI analysis report, not the execution status of the asynchronous task
IncidentInvestigationStatus.description_zh: AI 分析报告的结论状态，不是异步任务执行状态

IncidentInvestigationSummary.description_en: The summary of the AI analysis report
IncidentInvestigationSummary.example: 发现攻击尝试，建议核对目标资产。

IncidentUuid.description_en: The ID of the security event. You can obtain the ID by calling ListIncidents
IncidentUuid.description_zh: 安全事件 ID，可从 ListIncidents 获取

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number. Pages start from 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录总数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails

Message.description_en: The description of the request result or the cause of the failure
Message.description_zh: 请求结果说明或失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查请求问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values: true: successful. false: failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
